abilities.name: forewarn
abilities.effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

kanto.flavorText: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

original-johto.flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

hoenn.flavorText: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

updated-johto.flavorText: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.

original-unova.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

updated-unova.flavorText: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

kalos.flavorText: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a Drowzee has probably eaten it.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

original-alola.flavorText: It finds really fun dreams tasty. When it makes friends with people, it may show them the most delicious dreams it’s ever eaten.

updated-alola.flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn’t particularly like eating them.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
